units: <cite ref="Shabbat 139b:17">Sabb. 139ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ניהדק אינש צ׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (Ms. O. <cite ref="R00022"><he>צִבָּאתָא</he></cite>; ed. <cite ref="R00394"><he>צינייתא</he></cite>, read: <cite ref="R00299"><he>צִיבְיָיתָא</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 60) one must not stuff chips into the mouth of a jug (to let wine run through them).

<cite ref="Chullin 67a:11">Ḥull. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>לא לשפי</he> … <he>בצבתא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <he>בצבייתא</he>) one must not pour date-beer through chips &c. Ib. 105ᵇ <he>משום ציבתא</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="R00294"><he>צִיבְוָותָא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) on account of the chips (floating on top).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75b:1">Ab. Zar. 75ᵇ</cite> top <he>דצ׳</he> bands made of shavings; <cite ref="Tamid 30a">Tam. 30ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 29a">Succ. 29ᵃ</cite> a wind blew <he>וקא מייתי ציבותא</he> (Ms. M. 1 <cite ref="R00299"><he>ציבייתא</he></cite>; Ms. M. 2 <cite ref="R00322"><he>ציוותא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) and caused twigs and leaves (covering the Succah) to drop down (v. <cite ref="M02277"><he>מְצוֹבִיתָא</he></cite>).
